Flay city profiles, collected 2026-10-12

Natural Earth 1:10m Populated Places
Authors: Natural Earth contributors (Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso, and others)
Source: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-populated-places/
License: Public domain
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

GeoNames cities500
Attribution: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/
Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/cities500.zip
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: selected populated places, merged duplicate names, selected Korean names when supplied, and reviewed capital corrections listed in scripts/capital-overrides.json.
Population values are only used to select major places; they are not current population estimates.
The source snapshot URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in capital-cities.json.

Capital reference names also use mledoze/countries; see COUNTRIES-LICENSE.txt (ODbL).
Updated capitals and administrative roles use the official sources recorded per country in capital-cities.json.
